subject: Can I get CFI indices in mirt?

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Can I get CFI indices in mirt?
parts:
Dear all.

Can I get CFI indices in mirt?
I'm fitting my polytomous data with mirt().
But, I can get any CFI, TLI indices by default setting of mirt.

I want to get CFI indices with my polytomous data in the Full-Information Item Exploratory Factor Analysis.

How can I do that?

Here is my code.

result <- mirt(covdata, i, rotate = 'geominQ', calcNull = TRUE)
coef(result)
summary(result)
fitIndices(result, calcNull = TRUE)
residuals(result)
plot(result)

--
Blessings, Seongho.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Can I get CFI indices in mirt?
parts:
Hi Seongho,

It looks as though fitIndices(result, calcNull = TRUE) should have
also calculated TLI.M2 and CFI.M2 since you requested computing the M2
stat on the null model. Could you show what output you get from
fitIndices? It's possible you are using an older version of mirt that
didn't add that feature in yet. Cheers.

Phil

Hi Phil,

I was downloaded 'mirt' today. It's just two hours ago.

Hum, Finally I was fixing it.
Frankly speaking, I was for() command with mirt.
Anyway, I was modified the code

print(coef(result))
print(summary(result))
print(fitIndices(result, calcNull = TRUE))
print(residuals(result))
print(plot(result))

Finally, it works!

Thanks for your advice.
